scope: Same authored training corpus; make continuous language prior robust to image-like semantic uncertainty
hypothesis: Exact sentence embeddings yield clear prior controls but averaged image semantics cause nonword interpolation; train on ambiguous semantics with enough continuous modes
initialization: Warm-start v7 causal/context/subspace weights; expand8 context-dependent candidate heads to32 by four perturbed copies per old candidate
feature_augmentation: Per sentence:50% normalized class-mean text vector plus Gaussian0.01;30% exact sentence vector;10% exact vector plus Gaussian0.015;10% zero. Means use training rows only
objective: Best continuous candidate reconstruction +0.1 routing CE +0.2 numeric EOS BCE; previous-vector noise0.02
primary_generation: Sample top4 internal continuous modes at temperature0.5 with fixedseed42; use generated previous vectors; numeric EOS0.5 min1 max32; Qwen sampledseed42 cap105
diagnostic_generation: Greedy candidate text controls kept separate; no text IDs, vocabulary quantization or stored sentence lookup
evaluation: Same fixed text controls and existing image-plan plus null; no fresh candidate access
acceptance: Actual blinded human listening, no ASR-derived approval or artistic score
